I plan to make a website that gathers data from the NCAA website to help people find out more about the statistics of a team winning and takedown chances. 

## Top 10 teams by year

Choose a year from the chart menu to compare the top Division I teams by championship points. Rankings and points are from the [NCAA Division I wrestling records](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D1.pdf).

years <- as.character(2025:2015)
chart <- plot_ly()

for (year in years) {
  year_data <- team_results |>
    filter(.data$year == as.integer(year)) |>
    arrange(desc(points)) |>
    mutate(team_label = paste(rank, team))

  chart <- chart |>
    add_trace(
      data = year_data,
      x = ~points,
      y = ~team_label,
      type = "bar",
      orientation = "h",
      name = year,
      visible = year == "2025",
      hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>Team points: %{x}<extra></extra>"
    )
}

year_buttons <- map(years, \(year) {
  message <- case_when(
    year == "2020" ~ "The 2020 championship was canceled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )

  list(
    method = "update",
    label = year,
    args = list(
      list(visible = years == year),
      list(
        title = list(text = paste("Top 10 NCAA Division I teams —", year)),
        annotations = if (nzchar(message)) {
          list(list(
            text = message,
            x = 0.5,
            y = 0.5,
            xref = "paper",
            yref = "paper",
            showarrow = FALSE
          ))
        } else {
          list()
        }
      )
    )
  )
})

chart |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Top 10 NCAA Division I teams — 2025"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Championship points", rangemode = "tozero"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed"),
    updatemenus = list(list(
      type = "dropdown",
      buttons = year_buttons,
      x = 1,
      xanchor = "right",
      y = 1.15
    ))
  )
